description.zh: 缓存盘ID。可以通过DescribeGatewayCaches接口获得。
description.en: The ID of the cache disk. You can call the DescribeGatewayCaches operation to query the ID of the cache disk.

description.zh: 缓存盘内部设备名。 可以通过DescribeGatewayCaches接口获得。
description.en: The name of the device that corresponds to the cache disk. You can call the DescribeGatewayCaches operation to query the name of the device.

descriptions.zh:
使用该接口时，需要注意如下事项：

- 仅对线上网关有效。

- 仅支持删除按量付费的缓存盘。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, note the following:

- This operation is valid only for online gateways.
- You can delete only pay-as-you-go cache disks.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw delete-gateway-cache-disk --gateway-id gw-0001xv7je3580031y000 --cache-id d-bp1dcnq8zldree6ok000 --local-file-path /dev/vdb --region cn-hangzhou
